messages:
maya: Auditor requested an evidence bundle tying the Sept 14 incident to our logging/retention and KMS usage. They specifically want: CloudTrail entries, S3 access logs, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, k8s API audit slice showing RBAC changes to the CI service account, and the retention exception approval. Can we assemble a minimal, verifiable package by EOD Friday?

sam: I'll export Splunk and CloudTrail. Splunk query for combined S3/KMS actions around the incident window: 
```
index=prod_logs (s3:GetObject OR s3:PutObject OR KMS:Decrypt OR KMS:GenerateDataKey) earliest="2025-09-14T00:00:00" latest="2025-09-15T00:00:00" | table _time, src_user, src_ip, bucket, object, kms_key_id, action, request_id
```
I'll produce CSV and a short README describing the search.

alex: I've grabbed the Git history showing the accidental rolebinding change and a filtered kubectl apiserver audit (only events for ci-runner-sa). JQ snippet used: 
```
jq '.items[] | select(.objectRef.name=="ci-runner-sa") | {ts:.requestReceivedTimestamp, user:.user.username, verb:.verb, namespace:.objectRef.namespace}' apiserver-audit-2025-09-14.json
```
I'll include the git diff and the PR URL.

ops_oncall: Note: there was a retention exception (INC-4821) for lifecycle pause on the compliance bucket during that period. I can snapshot the S3 lifecycle config and the JIRA approval. Link: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-4821.

jordan: I approved the exception. I'll export the approval email thread and sign a one-page attestation PDF outlining why the exception was requested and dates covered.

lina: For KMS proof, CloudTrail raw events include requestParameters.keyId and userIdentity. If you want an Athena extract: 
```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.userName as principal, requestParameters.keyId AS kms_key_id, resources[1].ARN AS resource_arn
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventTime BETWEEN timestamp '2025-09-14 00:00:00' AND timestamp '2025-09-15 00:00:00'
AND eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey')
```
I can run and output CSV with header and MD5 checksum.

sam: Great. Also including request IDs so we can correlate across CloudTrail and Splunk.

maya: Auditor wants chain-of-custody: all exported artifacts need checksums (SHA256) and a manifest with the exact commands and tool versions used. Can deploybot create reproducible export scripts and run them?

deploybot: Yes. I'll push an export.sh that uses aws-cli v2 and jq, and produces a tar.gz plus export.sha256 and manifest.txt. Snippet: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-cloudtrail/2025/09/14/ ./ --recursive --profile audit && sha256sum *.json > export.sha256
```
I'll include AMI/cli/git hashes in manifest. Uploading to compliance-bucket/exports/1751613456/ with object ACL restricted and access logs enabled.

alex: Add the apiserver audit hash and the rolebinding Git commit SHA to the manifest so we can prove provenance.

jordan: For control mapping, I'll write a 1-page cover note linking each artifact to SOC 2 CC6.2 and ISO 27001 A.12.4 / A.9.2. Will include the acceptance checklist.

maya: Final artifact list: Splunk CSV (S3/KMS), CloudTrail Athena CSV, KMS raw events CSV, apiserver audit slice, rolebinding git diff + commit SHA, S3 lifecycle config snapshot, INC-4821 approval PDF, export.tar.gz, export.sha256, manifest.txt, and cover note with control mappings. Who will assemble archive?

ops_oncall: I'll assemble into the compliance bucket and generate a presigned URL with 7-day validity for the auditor. Will tag the object and enable object-level access logging.

sam: I'll upload the Splunk CSV and post the filename here when done.

lina: Uploaded CloudTrail CSV to s3://compliance-exports/1751613456/cloudtrail_kms.csv.gz. Manifest entry updated.

deploybot: export.sh, manifest.txt, and export.sha256 uploaded to s3://compliance-exports/1751613456/. Tarball export.tar.gz created containing all listed artifacts.

jordan: Handoff note drafted and uploaded as cover_note_1751613456.pdf. Listing mappings and signed by me.

maya: Thanks team. Target: URL to auditor and bundle checklist by 2025-09-18 17:00 PT. If anyone hits a blocker call me + ops_oncall. :thumbsup:
